run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute minimum sum of squares of character counts after removing k characters
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a PriorityQueue to greedily reduce highest character frequencies
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that calculates minimum sum of squares of character frequency counts given a string and k removals
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the PriorityQueue-based greedy approach with a heap-based solution
